conviction_note: The quarter itself sits inside a guide the company has repeated twice (stable US volumes, flat net price for the rest of 2026, cash up ~10% for the year), so the print should be near the bar. The new thing is 2027. CVS Health's own formulary update documents, dated 'current as of October 1, 2026', remove VASCEPA from the Standard Control and Value formularies effective 2027-01-01 and add generic icosapent ethyl. That points to losing the 'large national PBM' exclusivity Amarin regained in July 2025, and management has only ever guided payer exclusivity 'through the end of 2026'. Two things offset it: cash (~$315m+) is above the ~$247m market cap, and an active Barclays review with capital return 'being discussed'. That keeps p_up near 50 (44), so the scaled number (-0.84) is smaller than the findings' sum (-1.5).
bar: Q3 2026 total revenue consensus $43.71m (low $41.42m), 2 analysts, Yahoo Finance analysis page (https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AMRN/analysis/), snapshot via search. Only one source, so the findings that depend on the bar are capped small. The company gives no numeric revenue guide. Its stated 2026 guide (Q2 8-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000897448/000119312526323841/amrn-ex99_1.htm): US volumes consistent through the year, exclusivity with key payers through end-2026, cash +~10% by 2026-12-31 vs $302.6m (about $333m), positive cash flow. Q2 printed $42.2m against $45.5-46m consensus (a miss), while EPS beat (-0.07 vs -0.21).
positioning_check: Short interest was 528.4K ADS at the 2026-09-30 FINRA settlement, about 2.6% of ~20.6m ADS, with 10.5 days to cover because turnover is very thin (~67k ADS/day). It was flat against 525.8K at 09-15. Source: https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/amrn/short-interest/ and https://www.benzinga.com/quote/AMRN/sentiment. Not a crowded short. Skew: unavailable, because the chain is unusable (ATM spread 111% of mid, total OI 874, put/call OI 0.42). Tape: -8.68% over 20 days, +4.53% over 5 days, 37.6% below the 52-week high and 6% above the 52-week low. Sarissa Capital (activist, 13D) cut its stake from 8.08% to 6.09% (event date 2026-08-25).

findings.finding: CVS Health's 'Formulary Updates for Standard Control with Advanced Control Specialty Formulary effective January 1, 2027' lists VASCEPA* (multi-source brand) under Formulary Removals, with generic icosapent ethyl as the formulary option. Generic icosapent ethyl and LIPFENDRA are added. The Value Formulary document lists the same removal. Both documents are 'current as of October 1, 2026'. Amarin has guided only 'exclusives with key payers through the end of 2026'. It regained exclusive status with an unnamed 'large national PBM' on 2025-07-01, and CVS had removed Vascepa in mid-2024. So 2027 US volume (US product revenue was $32.2m of $42.2m in Q2, with a 48% share of the IPE market) is at risk of losing a major exclusive. The Q3 call is the first place management can be asked about 2027 contracts or an authorized-generic switch.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: US net-price and payer-driven revenue misses carried the big negative prints: 2025-10-29 -11.25%, 2026-02-25 -9.47% (Q4 call: US sales -7% on net price), 2025-03-12 -14.89%. The Q2 2026 revenue miss with an EPS beat moved +0.49%.
findings.why_not_priced: No news or analyst coverage connecting CVS's 2027 formulary to Amarin turned up in search: queries for 'Vascepa CVS 2027' return only 2020-2022 articles. The documents are plan-sponsor PDFs hosted on a state benefits site. Only two analysts publish estimates. If this were priced, consensus FY2027 US revenue would already show a step-down and the call previews would ask about 2027 exclusivity. Neither is visible. The -8.7% 20-day slide since early October may be partial leakage, so the size is moderate rather than large.
findings.independence: Same company, different document: the CVS Value Formulary Jan 2027 update (https://www.tn.gov/content/dam/tn/partnersforhealth/documents/Value_Formulary_JAN_2027.pdf) lists the same removal. These are two CVS documents of one decision, so they count once. The company's own hedged language ('through the end of 2026', Q1 transcript https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/04/30/amarin-amrn-q1-2026-earnings-transcript/) is consistent with it. Amarin has never named the PBM as CVS, so the link is an inference.

findings.finding: The Q3 cost line should come in light against the bar. The Supreme Court ended the Hikma induced-infringement case 9-0 on 2026-06-04, so the $6.3m of litigation-related charges in Q2 ($9.4m in 1H) should largely fall away in Q3. Opex excluding restructuring was already down 38% y/y, and inventory was cut by $19.5m in Q2. That points to a GAAP loss narrower than consensus, as in Q2 (-0.07 vs -0.21), and a third straight positive cash-flow quarter on the path to the ~$333m year-end cash guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 EPS beat with a revenue miss bought +0.49% (2026-07-29). The Q1 positive-cash-flow print bought +2.36%. The cost and EPS line has not paid much on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: The EPS bar comes from two analysts and missed by a wide margin last quarter, so the street models costs poorly. Even so, this sits inside what the company guided (lower opex, positive cash flow), the bar is single-sourced, and the size is capped small.
findings.independence: The end of the Hikma case is confirmed independently by the Supreme Court decision coverage (https://www.choate.com/insights/hikma-v-amarin-supreme-court-unanimously-rejects-induced-infringement-claims-in-generic-skinny-label-case/, 2026-06-05). The cost trend comes from the same 8-K.

findings.finding: Cash and investments of $314.6m (2026-06-30, no debt) exceed the equity value of about $247m (~20.6m ADS at $12.00). Barclays is the exclusive adviser on a strategic review, and the CEO said on the Q1 call that 'cash back to shareholders, of some sort is a concept that is being discussed and could possibly happen at the right time'. A capital-return or strategic announcement alongside the print is a live upside path.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior capital-return announcement exists. The 2026-01-08 preliminary-2025 release (positive cash flow, well positioned) moved +16.89%, the largest move in the history, which shows the stock can re-rate hard on balance-sheet news.
findings.why_not_priced: Trading below net cash, 6% above the 52-week low, says the market gives the review little probability or assigns value to future burn. If a return were expected, the stock would not sit at a discount to cash. Nothing dates an announcement to this print, so it is sized small for its probability.
findings.independence: The Q2 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000897448/000119312526323841/amrn-ex99_1.htm) confirms the $314.6m cash, no debt, and no buyback announced. That is a different document from the transcript.

findings.finding: Sarissa Capital (Alex Denner, a 13D filer) cut its holding from about 33.5m ordinary shares (8.08%) to 25.7m (6.09%), Amendment 16 with event date 2026-08-25. Continued selling by the largest activist is an overhang on a ~67k-ADS/day tape.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no print-day history on this line. The stock is -8.7% over 20 days and near its 52-week low since the filing.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public since August, so mostly priced. It is filed because supply from a holder who is still selling can cap any post-print rally on a stock with ~67k ADS of daily turnover.

outside_window.finding: The CVS 2027 removal hits US volume from 2027-01-01. The revenue effect itself lands in Q1 2027 results, after this window. Only the guidance and disclosure part can reach this print, and that part is filed above.

searched_and_found_nothing: Amarin news or 8-Ks since 2026-07-29: EDGAR shows only a Form 4 (2026-08-03) and the Sarissa 13D/A (2026-08-27); the company news page shows the ESC 2026 REDUCE-IT analyses (2026-08-24) and the Q3 date PR (2026-10-21)

rejected_candidates.candidate: Supreme Court 9-0 for Hikma (2026-06-04) ends Amarin's induced-infringement damages claim against generic skinny labels
rejected_candidates.detail: Merged into the cost-line finding (end of litigation charges). The loss of the damages claim itself is a June event long since in the price.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Recordati H1 2026: cardiovascular franchise -1.6%, 'mostly offset by the growing contribution of Vazkepa'; Amarin reports partner in-market demand +59% (Europe +69%)
rejected_candidates.detail: Supports the international supply line already guided ('continued international growth'). Europe is $5.4m of $42.2m and Recordati gives no number, so it adds nothing beyond the guide in the cost and EPS finding. Listed so the panel can weigh it.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with. The negative lean agrees with the -8.7% 20-day tape and the near-52-week-low price, but cuts against a stock trading below net cash, so p_up is held near 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar from a single source, 2 analysts on Yahoo only): capped the bar-dependent cost and EPS finding from +0.8 to +0.5, and noted it sits inside guidance
Rule 1 (the cost and EPS line has not paid on this name, +0.49% on Q2's beat): kept the reported-quarter finding small; p_up 45 to 44
Rule 6 (window): the 2027 revenue effect of the CVS removal is filed in outside_window; only the disclosure on the call stays in findings
Rules 7 and 8 (short interest 2.6% is not crowded; thin coverage): left the CVS guidance finding at -2.5 rather than shrinking it
